mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_outbox(event_id, community_id, booking_id, action, occurred_at, status, attempts, next_attempt_at, version) VALUES(#{row.eventId}, #{row.communityId}, #{row.bookingId}, #{row.action}, #{row.occurredAt}, 'READY', 0, #{row.occurredAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.community_id, a.role AS recipient_role, a.notification_version, eb.id AS binding_id, eb.version AS binding_version, g.id AS grant_id, g.notification_epoch AS grant_epoch, CASE WHEN a.role = 'STAFF' THEN #{assignmentVersion} ELSE NULL END AS assignment_version FROM user_account a LEFT JOIN elder_account_binding eb ON a.role = 'ELDER' AND eb.account_id = a.id AND eb.elder_id = #{elderId} AND eb.community_id = #{communityId} AND eb.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN booking_grant g ON a.role = 'FAMILY' AND g.family_id = a.id AND g.elder_id = #{elderId} AND g.community_id = #{communityId} AND g.revoked = FALSE AND g.expires_at > #{now} LEFT JOIN service_worker w ON a.role = 'STAFF' AND w.id = a.id AND w.community_id = #{communityId} AND w.enabled = TRUE WHERE a.community_id = #{communityId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.id != #{actorId} AND (a.role IN ('COMMUNITY_OPERATOR','PLATFORM_ADMIN') OR (a.role = 'ELDER' AND eb.id IS NOT NULL) OR (a.role = 'FAMILY' AND g.id IS NOT NULL) OR (a.role = 'STAFF' AND a.id = #{workerId} AND w.id IS NOT NULL))

SELECT id AS account_id, community_id, role AS recipient_role, notification_version FROM user_account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND community_id = #{communityId} AND role = 'STAFF' AND status = 'ACTIVE'

a.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND a.role = r.recipient_role AND a.notification_version = r.notification_version AND ( (r.action = 'TASK_TRANSFERRED' AND a.role = 'STAFF') OR (r.action != 'TASK_TRANSFERRED' AND ( a.role IN ('COMMUNITY_OPERATOR','PLATFORM_ADMIN') OR (a.role = 'ELDER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM elder_account_binding eb WHERE eb.id = r.binding_id AND eb.version = r.binding_version AND eb.active = TRUE AND eb.account_id = a.id AND eb.elder_id = b.elder_id AND eb.community_id = b.community_id)) OR (a.role = 'FAMILY' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM booking_grant g WHERE g.id = r.grant_id AND g.notification_epoch = r.grant_epoch AND g.family_id = a.id AND g.elder_id = b.elder_id AND g.community_id = b.community_id AND g.revoked = FALSE AND g.expires_at > #{now})) OR (a.role = 'STAFF' AND b.worker_id = a.id AND b.assignment_version = r.assignment_version AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service_worker w WHERE w.id = a.id AND w.community_id = b.community_id AND w.enabled = TRUE)) )) )

SELECT b.id AS booking_id, b.status, b.scheduled_start, b.scheduled_end, b.has_exception, CASE WHEN b.scheduled_end <= #{now} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS overdue,
CASE WHEN b.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'WAITING_START' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END CASE WHEN b.has_exception = TRUE THEN 'EXCEPTION' WHEN b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','IN_PROGRESS') AND b.scheduled_end <= #{now} THEN 'OVERDUE' ELSE 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION' END AS todo_type FROM service_booking b WHERE
AND b.status IN ('CONFIRMED','IN_PROGRESS')
